Definition: middle voice of G1210; to beg (as binding oneself), i.e. petition:--beseech, pray (to), make request. Compare G4441.
BiblicalUsage: This is the word for begging God, for asking with the whole heart behind the request. The disciples pray for boldness, Jesus tells His own to pray they may escape the things to come, Paul begs the Corinthians to receive him, and night after night he prays earnestly to see the Thessalonians again.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe begging God is not weakness but honesty. It admits we cannot manage on our own, and it is the posture of everyone in Scripture who ever got close to God — hands open, asking, and waiting for Him to answer.
